concept.title: The Frost of Morrime
concept.logline: On fog-bound, melancholy Morrime, you hold on long enough to recover the ember stones and restore the Frostpeak.
concept.source_prompt: Frost Peaks. snow mountain mountains peaks survival Last stand
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Hearth Lodge and becomes the one who brings the Frostpeak back to life.

key_locations.name: Hearth Lodge
key_locations.description: The start: a timber lodge dug into the drifts.

key_locations.name: Trapper Camp
key_locations.description: Trapper Camp: a camp on the way out from Hearth Lodge.

key_locations.name: Ice Jetty
key_locations.description: Ice Jetty: a dock on the way out from Hearth Lodge.

key_locations.name: Ice Cavern
key_locations.description: Ice Cavern: a cave of Morrime, reached by the trail from Hearth Lodge.

key_locations.name: Frozen Fort
key_locations.description: Frozen Fort: a ruin of Morrime, reached by the trail from Hearth Lodge.

key_locations.name: Frostpeak
key_locations.description: The frostpeak at the heart of the story, standing beyond Hearth Lodge.

characters.name: Warden Sefa
characters.description: Waits in Hearth Lodge and knows why the Frostpeak fell silent.

characters.name: Nadia the Tracker
characters.description: Follows you from Hearth Lodge and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Frost Stalker
characters.description: A frost stalker that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Corin the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Morrime for anything shiny.

characters.name: Snow Hare
characters.description: A harmless snow hare that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Hold out until the storm breaks
hazards: Sheer drops off the trail edges
Frost Stalker hunting near its lair

objectives.description: Warden Sefa says the storm is coming, and the finale must be held.
objectives.title: Speak with Warden Sefa

objectives.description: Survive until the storm breaks. Step out of it if you must.
objectives.title: Hold the Frostpeak for 30 seconds

objectives.description: Nadia the Tracker may know something useful.
objectives.title: Chat with Nadia the Tracker

objectives.description: Corin the Trader may know something useful.
objectives.title: Chat with Corin the Trader

objectives.description: Snow Hare may know something useful.

Check the landmark in Hearth Lodge

actions.value: On fog-bound, melancholy Morrime, you hold on long enough to recover the ember stones and restore the Frostpeak.
Reach the Frostpeak, light it, and hold out for 30 seconds.
The storm is here. Hold for 30 seconds!
The storm breaks. The Frostpeak held.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Warden Sefa
nodes.text: So you've come to Hearth Lodge at last. I am Warden Sefa. On fog-bound, melancholy Morrime, you hold on long enough to recover the ember stones and restore the Frostpeak.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Warden Sefa
nodes.text: Back again. Hearth Lodge is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Warden Sefa
nodes.text: Go to Trapper Camp, then Ice Jetty. Whatever still remembers The Frost of Morrime is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Warden Sefa
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Hearth Lodge, The Frost of Morrime was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Harsh, even then.

nodes.speaker: Warden Sefa
nodes.text: Trapper Camp: Trapper Camp: a camp on the way out from Hearth Lodge.

nodes.speaker: Warden Sefa
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of The Frost of Morrime back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Warden Sefa
nodes.text: Ice Jetty: Ice Jetty: a dock on the way out from Hearth Lodge.

nodes.speaker: Nadia the Tracker
nodes.text: Nadia the Tracker circles your feet, then looks toward Ice Jetty as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Nadia the Tracker
nodes.text: Nadia the Tracker sniffs the air. Something about Ice Jetty has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Nadia the Tracker
nodes.text: It turns toward Ice Jetty. Ice Jetty: a dock on the way out from Hearth Lodge.

nodes.speaker: Frost Stalker
nodes.text: The frost stalker watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Hearth Lodge. Corin the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of The Frost of Morrime that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Corin the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Trapper Camp after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Snow Hare
nodes.text: The snow hare freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
